# Meadow mathematics — teacher plan
2026 teacher-authored fixture. Grade 4. Week 4. 45 minutes.
Goal: explain why 1/2 and 2/4 describe the same portion of an equal-sized whole.
Sequence: draw equal-sized rectangles; partition one into 2 equal parts and one into 4; shade the named fractions; explain; independent comparison of 2/3 and 4/6.
Materials: board, notebooks, pencils. No printer required.
Key: each pair represents equal portions when the whole is the same size.
Support: partner oral rehearsal and a partial drawing; retain the teacher-supplied scribing accommodation.
